faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover SV P615 use?
faqLeft.a: The Range Rover SV (P615) uses the BMW S68 twin-turbo V8 — a 4.4-litre performance engine. This is the highest performance engine currently offered in the L460-generation Range Rover.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover SV P615 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover SV?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild BMW S68 Range Rover SV engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals and coolant components as standard on every S68 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover SV engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover SV if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SV P615 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover SV owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
